versions.changelog:
- Initial release of handraw-style: a catalog of 261 hand-drawn art style prompts.
- Features a numbered system for easy, consistent style referencing across GPT Image, Midjourney, and other AI image generators.
- Includes bilingual (Chinese/English) prompts for each style.
- Enables batch image generation with consistent visual identity.
- Provides usage examples and guidelines for different platforms.
